summary: Two Denver climbers (28 and 30) were stranded near the top of Redgarden Wall at dusk, close to hypothermic; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group reached them via the East Slabs and assisted them down in a ~6-hour rescue. Uninjured.
notes: ANAC 2022 edition (Pub 2022); one of two stranding incidents in same article; incident date Dec 18 per article.
